$description: Text roles (Plenix Styling Standard, section 6; owner, 2026-10-20: one uniform type system): each a W3C typography composite of existing tokens, with its word spacing as the companion ($extensions.plenix.wordSpacing). build-tokens.js writes each as six longhand tokens (--plx-sys-text-<role>-font-family, -font-size, -font-weight, -letter-spacing, -line-height, -word-spacing). A role sets the metrics (size, weight, letter spacing, line height) in DM Sans; Reddit Mono is not a role but a switch, text-mono-font-family with text-mono-word-spacing, that any role takes for a technical value or code. A component that establishes a role applies all six (the two font properties from the role or from the Mono switch); one that adjusts a role sets only the properties its contract names.

text-body.$description: Running text: the page's body text.

text-secondary.$description: Supporting text one step below the body: descriptions, metadata in words.

text-caption.$description: The smallest running text: captions, hints, help under a field.

text-label.$description: A label: names a field, a group or a value.

text-heading.$description: A section heading inside a page or a card.

text-eyebrow.$description: A small spaced label above a heading.

text-display.$description: The largest style: one key figure or a sign-in heading.

text-lead.$description: Body text one step up: the opening paragraph of a page.

text-mono-font-family.$description: The Mono switch (owner, 2026-10-20: one uniform type system): a technical value or code in any role takes Reddit Mono, fitted to DM Sans (size-adjust, platform/system/fonts.css), so it keeps the role's size, weight, line height and letter spacing and shares the baseline of the text beside it.

text-mono-word-spacing.$description: The Mono switch's word spacing: a space as wide as DM Sans's. Always set with text-mono-font-family.
